description:
Title: Ordering in an Online Shop  

A customer that logs into an E-Shop system and has to wait for its login confirmation (its credentials are checked by the system).
If the login was successful then the customer can continue to select products, else the shopping experience stops.
After selecting a product the customer has to add it to a shopping cart, save the product and check if every product was already selected.
These steps repeat until all products were selected.
Then the order is finished by the shopping system and simultaneously payment and shipment for the order is prepared.
For the payment the customer has to enter its payment data and has to wait until the bank confirms the payment.
While waiting for the payment confirmation the customer can enter its shipping address (an independent billing address can be entered if the shipping address is not equal to the billing address).
Finally if the address and the payment steps are executed then the order will be finished by the system.

<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance" id="Definitions_OnlineShop" targetNamespace="http://example.com/bpmn/online-shop">
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_PaymentData" name="Payment data"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_PaymentConfirmed" name="Payment confirmed"/>

  <bpmn:collaboration id="Collaboration_OnlineShop">
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_OnlineShop" name="E-Shop Online Ordering" processRef="Process_OnlineShop"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Bank" name="Bank"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_PaymentData" name="Payment data" sourceRef="UserTask_EnterPayment" targetRef="Participant_Bank" messageRef="Msg_PaymentData"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_PaymentConfirmed" name="Payment confirmed" sourceRef="Participant_Bank" targetRef="IntermediateCatchEvent_PaymentConfirmed" messageRef="Msg_PaymentConfirmed"/>
  </bpmn:collaboration>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_OnlineShop" name="Ordering in an Online Shop" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:laneSet id="LaneSet_OnlineShop">
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_Customer" name="Customer">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>StartEvent_Customer</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>UserTask_Login</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>SendTask_SendLogin</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>IntermediateCatchEvent_LoginConfirmed</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>EndEvent_ShoppingStopped</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_SelectionMerge</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>UserTask_SelectProduct</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>UserTask_AddToCart</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_SaveProduct</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_CheckAllSelected</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_AllSelected</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>UserTask_EnterPayment</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>IntermediateCatchEvent_PaymentConfirmed</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>UserTask_EnterShipping</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_BillingSplit</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>UserTask_EnterBilling</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_BillingMerge</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_EShopSystem" name="E-Shop System">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_CheckCredentials</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_CredentialsValid</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>SendTask_LoginConfirm</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>SendTask_LoginReject</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_FinishOrder</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_PrepSplit</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_PreparePayment</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_PrepareShipment</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_OrderJoin</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_CompleteOrder</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>EndEvent_OrderCompleted</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
    </bpmn:laneSet>

    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_Customer" name="Start shopping"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="UserTask_Login" name="Log in with credentials"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="SendTask_SendLogin" name="Send login request"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_CheckCredentials" name="Check login credentials"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_CredentialsValid" name="Credentials valid?" default="Flow_CredentialsInvalid"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="SendTask_LoginConfirm" name="Send login confirmation"/>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="IntermediateCatchEvent_LoginConfirmed" name="Login confirmation received"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="SendTask_LoginReject" name="Send login rejection"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_ShoppingStopped" name="Shopping stopped"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_SelectionMerge" name="Next product"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="UserTask_SelectProduct" name="Select product"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="UserTask_AddToCart" name="Add product to shopping cart"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_SaveProduct" name="Save product"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_CheckAllSelected" name="Check whether every product was selected"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_AllSelected" name="All products selected?" default="Flow_ProductsRemaining"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_FinishOrder" name="Finish order"/>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_PrepSplit" name="Start payment and shipment preparation"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_PreparePayment" name="Prepare payment"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="UserTask_EnterPayment" name="Enter payment data"/>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="IntermediateCatchEvent_PaymentConfirmed" name="Payment confirmation received">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MED_PaymentConfirmed" messageRef="Msg_PaymentConfirmed"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_PrepareShipment" name="Prepare shipment"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="UserTask_EnterShipping" name="Enter shipping address"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_BillingSplit" name="Billing address differs from shipping address?" default="Flow_BillingSame"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="UserTask_EnterBilling" name="Enter independent billing address"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_BillingMerge" name="Billing address handled"/>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_OrderJoin" name="Payment and address steps done"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_CompleteOrder" name="Complete order"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_OrderCompleted" name="Order completed"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_01" sourceRef="StartEvent_Customer" targetRef="UserTask_Login"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_02" sourceRef="UserTask_Login" targetRef="SendTask_SendLogin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_03" sourceRef="SendTask_SendLogin" targetRef="Task_CheckCredentials"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_04" sourceRef="Task_CheckCredentials" targetRef="Gateway_CredentialsValid"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_CredentialsValid" sourceRef="Gateway_CredentialsValid" targetRef="SendTask_LoginConfirm">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${credentialsValid}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_CredentialsInvalid" sourceRef="Gateway_CredentialsValid" targetRef="SendTask_LoginReject"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_07" sourceRef="SendTask_LoginConfirm" targetRef="IntermediateCatchEvent_LoginConfirmed"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_08" sourceRef="IntermediateCatchEvent_LoginConfirmed" targetRef="Gateway_SelectionMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_09" sourceRef="SendTask_LoginReject" targetRef="EndEvent_ShoppingStopped"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_10" sourceRef="Gateway_SelectionMerge" targetRef="UserTask_SelectProduct"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_11" sourceRef="UserTask_SelectProduct" targetRef="UserTask_AddToCart"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_12" sourceRef="UserTask_AddToCart" targetRef="Task_SaveProduct"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_13" sourceRef="Task_SaveProduct" targetRef="Task_CheckAllSelected"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_14" sourceRef="Task_CheckAllSelected" targetRef="Gateway_AllSelected"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ProductsRemaining" sourceRef="Gateway_AllSelected" targetRef="Gateway_SelectionMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_AllSelected" sourceRef="Gateway_AllSelected" targetRef="Task_FinishOrder">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${allProductsSelected}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_17" sourceRef="Task_FinishOrder" targetRef="Gateway_PrepSplit"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_18" sourceRef="Gateway_PrepSplit" targetRef="Task_PreparePayment"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_19" sourceRef="Task_PreparePayment" targetRef="UserTask_EnterPayment"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_20" sourceRef="UserTask_EnterPayment" targetRef="IntermediateCatchEvent_PaymentConfirmed"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_21" sourceRef="IntermediateCatchEvent_PaymentConfirmed" targetRef="Gateway_OrderJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_22" sourceRef="Gateway_PrepSplit" targetRef="Task_PrepareShipment"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_23" sourceRef="Task_PrepareShipment" targetRef="UserTask_EnterShipping"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_24" sourceRef="UserTask_EnterShipping" targetRef="Gateway_BillingSplit"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_BillingDiffers" sourceRef="Gateway_BillingSplit" targetRef="UserTask_EnterBilling">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${billingAddressDiffers}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_BillingSame" sourceRef="Gateway_BillingSplit" targetRef="Gateway_BillingMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_27" sourceRef="UserTask_EnterBilling" targetRef="Gateway_BillingMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_28" sourceRef="Gateway_BillingMerge" targetRef="Gateway_OrderJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_29" sourceRef="Gateway_OrderJoin" targetRef="Task_CompleteOrder"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_30" sourceRef="Task_CompleteOrder" targetRef="EndEvent_OrderCompleted"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
